items.informal_name: Component Norm Inequality in Product $ L^p $ Spaces
items.type:
∀ {p : ENNReal} {ι : Type u_2} {β : ι → Type u_4} [hp : Fact (1 ≤ p)] [inst : Fintype ι]
  [inst_1 : (i : ι) → SeminormedAddCommGroup (β i)] (x : PiLp p β) (i : ι), ‖x.ofLp i‖ ≤ ‖x‖
items.informal_description: For any element $ x $ in the product $ L^p $ space $ \Pi L^p $ and for each index $ i $, the norm of the component $ x_i $ is bounded above by the norm of $ x $, i.e., $ \|x_i\| \leq \|x\| $. This inequality holds for all finite index types $ \iota $ and families of normed groups $ \beta_i $, with the norm on $ \Pi L^p $ defined according to the exponent $ p $.

items.informal_name: Component Norms are Bounded by Product Supremum Norm
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {G : ι → Type u_4} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : (i : ι) → SeminormedAddGroup (G i)] (f : (i : ι) → G i)
  (i : ι), ‖f i‖ ≤ ‖f‖
items.informal_description: In a product of seminormed additive groups indexed by a finite type $\iota$, equipped with the supremum seminorm, the norm of each component $f(i)$ of an element $f$ is less than or equal to the norm of $f$ itself, i.e., $\|f(i)\| \leq \|f\|$ for all $i \in \iota$.

items.informal_name: Component Norm Inequality in L^p Space
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_3} {E : α → Type u_4} {p : ENNReal} [inst : (i : α) → NormedAddCommGroup (E i)],
  p ≠ 0 → ∀ (f : ↥(lp E p)) (i : α), ‖↑f i‖ ≤ ‖f‖
items.informal_description: For any index $i$ and any function $f$ in the $L^p$ space with $p \neq 0$, the norm of the component $f(i)$ is bounded above by the $L^p$ norm of $f$, i.e., $\|f(i)\| \leq \|f\|$.

items.informal_name: Componentwise Non-negative Norm Inequality in Product $ L^p $ Spaces
items.type:
∀ {p : ENNReal} {ι : Type u_2} {β : ι → Type u_4} [hp : Fact (1 ≤ p)] [inst : Fintype ι]
  [inst_1 : (i : ι) → SeminormedAddCommGroup (β i)] (x : PiLp p β) (i : ι), ‖x.ofLp i‖₊ ≤ ‖x‖₊
items.informal_description: For a finite index set $\iota$ and a family of seminormed additive commutative groups $\beta(i)$, and for any element $x$ in the product $L^p$ space $\Pi L^p$ and any index $i$, the non-negative norm of the $i$-th component of $x$ satisfies $\|x_i\|_+ \leq \|x\|_+$. This inequality reflects that the norm of each component is bounded by the overall norm in the product space structure.

items.informal_name: Component Norms are Bounded by Supremum Norm in Product Seminormed Additive Groups
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {G : ι → Type u_4} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : (i : ι) → SeminormedAddGroup (G i)] (f : (i : ι) → G i)
  (i : ι), ‖f i‖₊ ≤ ‖f‖₊
items.informal_description: For any element $f$ in the product space $\prod_{i \in \iota} G_i$ of seminormed additive groups indexed by a finite type $\iota$, the norm of each component $f(i)$ satisfies $\|f(i)\|_+ \leq \|f\|_+$, where $\|\cdot\|_+$ denotes the non-negative seminorm and the product space is equipped with the supremum seminorm.
